title: PJM desperately needs grid batteries. Here’s a way it could get some.

meta.summary: PJM Interconnection is finally taking steps that could let a lot of new battery capacity connect to its grid without eons of delay.  PJM is the biggest grid operator in the U.S., serving customers across 13 mid-Atlantic, Midwestern, and Southern states.
